definition: Every first mover really has every pure perfection: for every first mover f and every d with Pure d, Has f d.
note: Open, unattributed. The existing FirstUnmovedMoverHasEveryPerfection is its instance where every respect is a real determination and every determination is pure (everyPerfectionIsAllPureCase). A form that is simple but limited, such as a pure immaterial form lacking other forms' perfections, does not satisfy it.
